messages:
maya: quick note: i'm building a keyboard-first quick-grant in the console (press 'g'). goal: 1-tap grants for common presets. main worry: silent routing or quota changes. thoughts?
sam: do simulation + audit before apply. we had customers hit fallback routes when entitlements changed. no silent paths.
li: show an 'effective impact' mini preview: routes affected + quota buckets. ops teams need that.
jordan: gate sensitive scopes. if role includes routing scopes (eg: 'route_admin') open full modal; don't allow quick-grant.
maya: plan: server-side sensitive_scopes list + client check. latency concern?
nora: simulate+audit+apply can be 700-900ms. consider optimistic UI + clear rollback. also telemetry needs flow tag.
sam: telemetry shape: flow=quick|modal, sensitive_hit=true|false, simulate_ok=true|false, apply_latency_ms, reverted=true|false. sample impacted_route_ids at 1%.
ops-bot: deploy: feature flag console.quick_grant_kb enabled on staging.
maya: API idea: atomic endpoint PATCH /authz/grants/atomic {"principal","roles","apply_after_simulate":true} so server simulates and applies atomically.
sam: require server revalidate within 2s to avoid races; return 409 on conflict.
jordan: add X-Requested-By: console-quickgrant header to separate UI calls in telemetry.
li: test plan: syrup tests for user/svc-account, route_admin, quota roles, concurrent grants. assert telemetry + audit + no silent routing drift.
maya: i'll prototype and open PR with telemetry schema and rollout-context in simulate. ping when ready for review.
